e4121f7e-41c1-448f-98df-a019d764c17a.title: Reiwa no Dara-san
e4121f7e-41c1-448f-98df-a019d764c17a.description:
On a stormy day, a landslide destroys a fence, and siblings who ventured into a long-prohibited area encounter a terrifyingly bizarre creature…

“I'm a curse god, you know!? Don't you think anything of this grotesque form?!?”

The unflappable siblings, rather than being scared, casually call the creature “Dara-san” and grow fond of her!?
___

36f7cd2a-c210-4504-8c81-a7ec82e5e3b4.title: Top Dog Kim Jian
36f7cd2a-c210-4504-8c81-a7ec82e5e3b4.description:
A loser named Kim Jian transferred to Sujung High School... But actually, he’s the top dog of them all... and he's a girl!!
Jian’s parents, worried about their troublemaking daughter who’s been in fights with boys in the past, want to send her only to an all-girls school. But Jian wants to attend a co-ed school.
In the end, she’s allowed to go—on the condition that she'll disguise herself as a boy and keep it quiet...
But it’s already getting noisy!! -_-^

ad9feb8d-4c82-49c2-8e66-e249afbfb0ba.title: Name.
ad9feb8d-4c82-49c2-8e66-e249afbfb0ba.description:
Toame is a high school freshman who just got his very first girlfriend. He should be at the peak of his happiness right now, but he constantly has a troubled expression. The truth is, there is an unspeakable “secret” between him and Namehata, the most beautiful girl in his grade. Toame wants nothing more than to break his relationship with Namehata, but he finds himself sinking deeper and deeper into this downward spiral.

83059e8f-9393-485d-845a-9eb33e0e368c.description:
Suit up! 

Jian is an Italian soccer league benchwarmer who needs to convince his childhood friend that he's a star player. A lucky goal or two might do the trick, but how long can he keep up the ruse? 

Unless, unbeknownst to him, Jian really is a genius...

7b2caa36-8725-4f01-959d-e8e1bbf1f1a8.title: 2gether the series
7b2caa36-8725-4f01-959d-e8e1bbf1f1a8.description:
Cha Taein is a very handsome student and cheerleader in college, while Yoo Soohyuk is one of the campus’ most popular guys and is also in the soccer and music club. When Taein is chased by Lim Gurin, who he does not reciprocate feelings for — he ends up begging Soohyuk to fake date with him in order to chase Lim Gurin away.
Somehow, just like the tale as old as time goes — pretense somehow starts to turn into reality. However, before a "happily ever after" there is the process of falling in love, and the slow realization that somehow they aren't pretending anymore. Somehow, they do not want to.
